response: {"texts":[{"id":"R7.5.0(2)","text":"Before infusion, the door must be closed and locked."},{"id":"R8.1.0(1)","text":"Clinicians authorization to operate the PCA pump must be authenticated."},{"id":"R8.1.0(2)","text":"Patient’s identity and admittance to the hospital must be authenticated."},{"id":"R8.1.0(3)","text":"Drug container must have a valid prescription for the particular patient to be infused by the PCA pump."},{"id":"R8.1.0(4)","text":"Drug library information shall be authenticated before it is accepted."},{"id":"R8.2.0(1)","text":"Patient information must be restricted to those providing care for the patient, and the patient."},{"id":"R8.3.0(2)","text":"The provisioning jack must be physically inaccessible, except to authorized technical personnel."},{"id":"R8.3.0(3)","text":"Provisioning (or re-provisioning) shall not be possible through an ICE network."},{"id":"R8.3.0(4)","text":"Provisioning shall be a single, unitary block-transfer."}]}
